config.title: Berlin Giant Kite Festival 2026 - FAQ
config.subtitle: The date, free entry and how to approach Tempelhofer Feld sensibly.

items.q: When is the Giant Kite Festival in Berlin in 2026?
items.a: The 13th STADT UND LAND Giant Kite Festival is on Saturday 12 September 2026, from 11:00 to 20:00 at Tempelhofer Feld.

items.q: Is the Giant Kite Festival free?
items.a: Yes. The organiser lists free admission for the 2026 event.

items.q: Can visitors bring their own kite?
items.a: Yes. The organiser says visitors are invited to bring and fly their own kites alongside the organised programme. Check the current event guidance before you go.

items.q: Which entrance should I use for the Giant Kite Festival?
items.a: Choose from the organiser's event-day approach information based on where you are travelling from. The field has several access points, so one static meeting pin is not a reliable answer for everyone.

items.q: Should I meet at S+U Tempelhof for the festival?
items.a: No. The organiser expects temporary closures around S+U Tempelhof, Tempelhofer Damm and nearby motorway exits from roughly 12:00 to 19:00. Check the current organiser notice and a live route before leaving.
